title: First pillar of Islam – the Shahadah
intro: The pillars of Islam are the main duties of a Muslim. The first one is to say the Shahadah.

learn.html: The pillars of Islam are the main Islamic duties, and there are five of them. The first pillar of Islam – and the first main duty – is to say the Shahadah (Kalimat ash-shahadah).

learn.label: The Shahadah
learn.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
learn.tr: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasooluhu
learn.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad (SAW) is Allah’s servant and Messenger.

items.label: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaah – With the first part we confirm that we believe Allah (SWT) exists and that He is One. With it we show we obey Allah.
Wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasooluhu – With the second part we confirm that Muhammad (SAW) is Allah’s servant and Messenger. With it we show we follow the Prophet.

learn.html: From the moment we say the Shahadah for the first time, we promise to do what Allah (SWT) has commanded, to stay away from what He has forbidden, and to follow the Sunnah of the Prophet (SAW).

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The Sunnah is everything the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) said, did, or silently approved of when others did it.
When we say the Shahadah often, our faith and our obedience to Allah (SWT) and His Messenger grow stronger.

learn.title: 💬 Talk with your muallim
learn.html: The Shahadah in my heart, on my tongue and in what I do.

questions.q: How many pillars of Islam are there?
What is the first pillar of Islam?
What do we confirm with the first part of the Shahadah?
options: That Allah exists and is One
That the Prophet was a merchant

questions.q: What do we confirm with the second part of the Shahadah?
options: That Muhammad (SAW) is Allah’s servant and Messenger
That angels are made of light
That the Ka‘bah is in Makkah
What the Prophet (SAW) said, did or approved
